reasons.A: Closest movement and stance: short declaratives and fragments, first-person plainness with small personal asides ('I do not mind'), no contractions, calm matter-of-fact tone like the passage.
reasons.C: Short sentences and fragments fit, but it leans on second-person imperatives more than the passage's first-person account and stacks clipped fragments ('Small stitch. Turn. Back again.') a bit thicker than the author does.
reasons.B: Long, multi-clause explanatory sentences, formal instructional register ('it is worth looking closely', 'helps stabilise') and enumerated 'The first... The second...' structure are far from the passage's terse, plain rhythm.
